feature: Daftar eksklusi e-notification (opt-out) dikelola staff: halaman Exclusion dan CRUD ocms_enotification_exclusion_list
note: Mirip story OCMS50.10 (Removed) tetapi hanya staff yang mengisi daftar id_no; offender tidak punya opsi sendiri di portal. Tidak ada kolom channel SMS vs email. Endpoint delete dan exists tidak ada di mapping api-authorization.properties:156.
note_en: Similar to story OCMS50.10 (Removed) but only staff fill the id_no list; offenders have no option of their own in the portal. No SMS vs email channel column. The delete and exists endpoints are not in the api-authorization.properties:156 mapping.

feature: Cron notifikasi SMS/email melewati ID yang ada di daftar eksklusi (ENA dipindah ke RD1 jalur kertas)
note: Efek opt-out ada di cron: ID terkecualikan di-skip dan tahap ENA pindah ke RD1 hari berikutnya. loadAllExcludedIds fail-open (set kosong bila query gagal). Prod properties sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) dan email.enableSmtp=false (:80); nilai server sebenarnya cannot verify from repo.
note_en: The opt-out effect lives in the cron: excluded IDs are skipped and the ENA stage moves to RD1 the next day. loadAllExcludedIds is fail-open (empty set when the query fails). Prod properties sms.enable=false (application-prod.properties:87) and email.enableSmtp=false (:80); the real server values cannot verify from repo.
